no_earlier_than.establishes: this document was created AFTER this block existed, because it names its hash

no_later_than.establishes: this document existed BEFORE the Bitcoin block that commits the calendar attestation
no_later_than.status: pending — calendars aggregate then commit; run `ots upgrade` to pull the attestation

note: Two one-sided bounds make a window. Neither half is evidence alone: a self-recorded height is a number anyone can type, and a timestamp with no lower bound cannot exclude back-dating. Together they bracket creation between two Bitcoin blocks.
